addToBasket.name: addToBasket
addToBasket.description: Add an item to a basket, or increase its quantity if already present.

getBasket.name: getBasket
getBasket.description: Get basket for the current user or session. Creates one if it does not exist.

removeFromBasket.name: removeFromBasket
removeFromBasket.description: Remove an item from a basket entirely.

listItems.name: listItems
listItems.description: List items, optionally filtered by category or search query.

cancelOrder.name: cancelOrder
cancelOrder.description: Cancel a pending order and restore stock.

getOrder.name: getOrder
getOrder.description: Get a single order. Users can only access their own orders.

listOrders.name: listOrders
listOrders.description: List orders for the current user.
